title: Fill in the Blank
description: Type the missing words into the gaps.
instructions: Every question in this quiz is of one type: Fill in the Blank.
Use it to test how this question type looks and is marked.

questions.question: The pH of a neutral solution at 25 °C is {{1}}, and an acid turns blue litmus paper {{2}}.
questions.explanation: Neutral is pH 7. Acids turn blue litmus red.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is the {{1}}, and the SI unit of energy is the {{2}}.
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons and energy in joules.

questions.question: A loop that never stops running is called an {{1}} loop.
questions.explanation: The loop condition never becomes false.

questions.question: A triangle with three equal sides is called {{1}}, and each of its angles is {{2}} degrees.
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle add up to 180°, so each is 60°.
